title: Memory
description: Each agent gets a dedicated knowledge space by default. Multiple agents can share a space.
name: Space name
emptyDescription: Bind a space to extract reusable experience when an issue reaches Done.
notConfigured: The knowledge service is not configured.
memberWait: Ask a workspace owner or admin to bind a knowledge space.
confirmUnbind: Detach this knowledge space? Existing knowledge stays in the space. Pending extraction jobs will be removed.
noExtractions: Completed issues will appear here when extraction starts.
memoryDescription: Each agent gets a dedicated knowledge space by default. Multiple agents can share a space.
memoryDetached: No knowledge space is bound. Extraction and recall are paused.
changeMemoryDescription: Choose a knowledge space. Spaces used by other agents can be shared.
detachMemoryDescription: Detach this knowledge space? Its content will remain, and this agent will stop extraction and recall.
deleteMemoryDescription: Permanently delete “{{name}}” and its chat memory? All agents using this knowledge space will be detached. Independent skill, Wiki and CodeGraph assets remain in Memory.
deleteBoundMemory: Also permanently delete the bound knowledge space, if any
keepMemoryDescription: Leave unchecked to keep the knowledge space. Shared spaces must be retained while other agents use them.
